newsitem.title: USA: August municipal bond issues total $12.3 bln - SDC.
newsitem.headline: August municipal bond issues total $12.3 bln - SDC.

text.p: New municipal issues numbered 679 in August and totaled $12.3 billion, according to Securities Data Co.
That compares to 838 issues totaling $13.3 billion in August 1995. Securities Data figures exclude private placements, short-term notes and non-profit issues.
Smith Barney Inc was August's top underwriter, serving as lead manager on 28 issues totaling $1.872 billion for a 15.3 percent market share, SDC said.

Goldman Sachs & Co was second with 19 issues totaling $1.482 billion for a 12.1 percent market share. Merrill Lynch & Co was third with 19 issues totaling $1.433 billion for an 11.7 percent market share.
